2610.09927.title: KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment
2610.09927.paper_summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.
2610.09927.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜嵌入（KGE）模型將知識圖譜的實體和關係編碼到低維潛在空間中，使得分類或鏈接預測等任務成為可能。大多數 KGE 模型遵循自編碼器架構，其中編碼器將知識圖譜投影到潛在空間，而解碼器則重建它。結合編碼器和解碼器組件的需求日益增加，但現有的庫很少支持完整的自編碼器，通常未得到維護，依賴於未記錄的默認超參數，並且產生的結果無法在庫之間進行比較。在這裡，我們介紹 KGATE（知識圖譜自編碼器訓練環境），這是一個基於 PyTorch Geometric 和 TorchKGE 的模組化 Python 庫。KGATE 允許用戶將初始化器、編碼器、解碼器、損失函數、負樣本生成器和評估指標組合為構建塊，或插入他們自己的構建塊。KGATE 包含一個控制數據洩漏的預處理程序、一個內建的訓練管道，以及設計上的可重現性。與六個現有的 KGE 庫進行基準測試顯示，KGATE 的訓練時間與最快的庫相當，同時提供更廣泛的功能集。
